title: Automorphic L-Functions from Sigma–Rho Poisson Summation
statement: Prove that the conjectural $(\sigma,\rho)$-Poisson summation formula implies meromorphic continuation and the functional equation of the automorphic $L$-function $L(s,\sigma,\rho)$.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Automorphic Forms, Geometry and Arithmetic (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/39, pp. 2089--2156](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/39)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The GLn identity is established, and refined Poisson formulas are known for selected Braverman--Kazhdan spaces, but the proposed direct proof for all split classical groups with the standard representation remains an expected extension rather than a general theorem.
